parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit, 1-128 printable ASCII characters) that makes a retried request safe. Required on every POST and PUT (400 `idempotency-key-required`; `idempotency-key-invalid` when malformed). A replay with the same key, method, path and body returns the original response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.
